items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: Nat Toles became the leader of that band and I stayed with that band.

ctx.x: Was your schooling at all interrupted by all that touring with the band?

Yeah, I did. You see, I finished. Then I didn't go to college until maybe after I'd been playing with Holder. You know, I didn't until I got a chance to -- I was playing with Holder. So when they said they'd give me a scholarship in music if I would come down and play with the band. So when I went -- that's when I went, like around 1930 -- after leaving Andy Kirk. See, I joined Andy Kirk and I went -- I says, "I think I'm going to take this up and go back home." So we went there and that's the band that Nat Toles…
